'''Banok Ral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Dread Commander of the [[Dread Host]] during the [[Dread War]]. He was stationed on [[Oricon]] in [[3638 BBY]] patrolling the outer sections perimeter and [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] of the [[Dread Fortress]] when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Banok Ral is one of eight Dread Host Commanders who serve as part of the Oricon planetary quest line in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''. As part of the final mission of that quest line a Republic or Imperial player is tasked with killing these commanders and destroying transports in order to prevent the spread of the [[Dread Masters]]' fear across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
